# IDENTITÉ Therapeutics

> IDENTITÉ Therapeutics publishes information about its ocular surface research and resources for DOSS Visual Acuity, an iPhone visual acuity screening chart.

## Public pages

- [IDENTITÉ Therapeutics](https://identitetherapeutics.com/): Company and ocular surface research overview.
- [DOSS Visual Acuity](https://identitetherapeutics.com/visualacuity): App information and device requirements.
- [DOSS Visual Acuity support](https://identitetherapeutics.com/visualacuity/support): Setup, chart controls, troubleshooting, and support contact.
- [DOSS Visual Acuity privacy policy](https://identitetherapeutics.com/visualacuity/privacy): On-device processing, saved screening sessions, and optional sharing.
